title: Circuit-Level Appliance Runtime Cost
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue (`emporia:circuit`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, and smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=emporia:circuit
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(kwh) as kwh by circuit _time
| eval est_cost=round(kwh*0.30,2)
| sort - est_cost
description: Turns circuit-level energy into an estimated monthly cost so your laundry room, office rack, or EV gear can be discussed in dollars instead of vague guilt.
value: People change behaviour faster when usage becomes money; a cost-ranked circuit view makes the expensive loads obvious.
implementation: Forward Emporia circuit telemetry with kWh counters; refresh monthly and compare the top circuits against expected household habits.
visualization: Monthly bar chart of circuits by estimated energy cost.
grandmaExplanation: It warns what each part of your home is roughly costing to run each month in electricity.
